name: V4
description: V4 is an apartment building under way in Vijayanagar 4th Stage. Twenty-four 3 BHK homes range from 1,678 to 1,870 sq ft, each with a deep balcony.

gallery.alt: The V4 apartment block at dusk, angular balconies stepping across a dark elevation with the interiors lit.
A kitchen inside a V4 apartment, with pale cabinetry and a run of wall units.
The V4 block seen from the corner, balconies running the length of the elevation.
The V4 elevation in white render, each floor set back behind a deep balcony.
A bathroom inside a V4 apartment, finished in veined stone.
The V4 block along its street frontage, lit at dusk.
An evening view of V4, warm light behind the balcony line.
